_comment: Source of truth for asset provenance, licensing, and visual-style metadata. One entry per pack. See AGENTS.md in this folder for how to read, add to, and maintain this file. Every directory under assets/ MUST have an entry here.

kaykit.look: Flat-shaded low-poly, painterly hand-authored palette texture atlas, soft rounded forms, warm saturated colors.
kaykit.scale: Real-world-ish, Y-up, ~1 Godot unit = 1 meter. Humanoids ~1.7-1.8u tall. Dungeon pieces snap to a 1-unit modular grid.
kaykit.rig: Shared KayKit humanoid skeleton; all KayKit characters reuse the KayKit Character Animations set.
kaykit.texture: A single shared palette PNG atlas per pack (e.g. *_texture.png); recoloring = remap UVs on the atlas, not per-mesh textures.
kaykit.notes: This is the project's primary 3D style. New 3D should join this group whenever possible — same-creator is the only hard guarantee that models blend.

kenney-2d.look: Clean vector/flat UI and input-prompt iconography.

game-icons-net.look: Monochrome single-path silhouette icons, recolored at runtime via modulate.
game-icons-net.notes: Inventory/ability iconography. Mixed individual authors under one CC BY license.

quaternius.look: Flat-shaded low-poly, cleaner/cartoonier than KayKit, single Atlas texture per model, slightly chunkier proportions.
quaternius.scale: Y-up, ~1 Godot unit = 1m, rigged humanoid armature (EnemyArmature/CharacterArmature) with its own animation set (Idle/Walk/Run/Attack/Death/HitReact).
quaternius.notes: A deliberate SECOND 3D style group, brought in for free CC0 animated monsters (KayKit has none free). Reads more cartoony than KayKit — acceptable for enemies, verified by in-engine side-by-side. Animation names differ per model; the enemy AnimationTree maps them per-monster.

unsorted.notes: Triage required — assign a real group or document why it stands alone.

packs.name: CC0 creature skeleton and motion references
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.notes: Authoring-only wolf, rat, spider and blob rigs. Wolf: https://poly.pizza/m/P1gU3Qkr9r ; rat: https://poly.pizza/m/iltq5bVNaV . Public source-metadata.json records exact CC0 editions; profiles record hashes, clip maps, scales and bone roles. Spider/blob are existing project CC0 acquisitions. These source models are motion/weight references, not approved visual replacements or new gameplay enemies. Preserve original authorship and edition-specific CC0 evidence; current general site license differs.

packs.name: KayKit - Character Pack : Adventurers
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Rigged/animated humanoid characters (Knight, Mage, Rogue, Barbarian) plus held weapon meshes. Player character source.

packs.name: KayKit - Character Animations (1.1)
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Standalone animation set (no characters) as glTF: Rig_Medium (133 clips in General, MovementBasic/Advanced, CombatMelee/Ranged, Simulation, Special, Tools) and Rig_Large (fewer clips, a bigger skeleton with different proportions), plus bare mannequins. Rig_Medium matches the Skeleton_Warrior rig our kit characters use (same bones, rest pose identical), so its clips play on them unchanged; it omits the old IK/control helper bones. Clip names differ from the clips embedded in the older KayKit characters (e.g. 1H_Melee_Attack_Chop -> Melee_1H_Attack_Chop, Spellcast_Raise -> Ranged_Magic_Raise). FBX copies left out.

packs.name: KayKit - Dungeon Pack (legacy / pre-remaster)
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Older dungeon prop/weapon set using the *.gltf.glb naming and rarity suffixes (_common/_uncommon/_rare). Kept alongside the remaster; prefer remastered where equivalents exist.

packs.name: KayKit - Dungeon Pack Remastered
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Primary dungeon environment set (~200 modular pieces): walls, floors, banners, props. Drives level generation tiling.

packs.name: KayKit - Skeletons Character Pack
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Animated skeleton enemies + modular skeleton parts/weapons. Current enemy source.

packs.name: Kenney - Input Prompts
packs.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
packs.notes: Keyboard + Xbox controller button prompt SVGs for UI hints. Directory name keeps the original 'kenny' spelling.

packs.name: game-icons.net icon set
packs.author: Various authors via game-icons.net (per-icon attribution required)
packs.notes: ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED. Item/equipment SVG icons. Each icon has an individual author that must be credited in shipped builds. Per-icon authorship is not yet recorded here — needs backfill (see AGENTS.md).

packs.name: UI background art (unverified)
packs.author: UNKNOWN — needs triage
packs.notes: main_menu_background.png has no recorded source or license. MUST be triaged before shipping: confirm origin/terms, or replace with an asset of known provenance.

packs.name: Rogue Gauntlet - Custom Generated 3D Items
packs.author: Rogue Gauntlet contributors (AI-assisted + KayKit palette)
packs.notes: Low-poly flat-shaded 3D items UV-mapped to KayKit's dungeon_texture.png and aligned to KayKit reference AABBs.

packs.name: Rogue Gauntlet - Custom Monsters
packs.author: Rogue Gauntlet contributors; CC0 rigs/animations by Kay Lousberg and Quaternius; wolf/rat geometry adapted from Quaternius
packs.notes: Monsters built from the scripted character kit (heads, bodies, garments, armor and accessories by script), one folder per family: goblin/goblin (0.74x), mage/necromancer, mage/dark_wizard, orc/orc_king, orc/orc_warrior, orc/orc_shaman, undead/mummy, undead/wraith, undead/ghoul (0.92x), undead/zombie_walker and demon/imp (0.68x). Each GLB is a drop-in on a copy of KayKit's Skeleton_Warrior.glb (its Rig, 41 joints and 95 clips) with only the meshes ours; weapons are the game's own items baked in at true size. Sources (recipes, concept drawings by Google gemini-3-pro-image over KayKit's CC0 mannequin, previews) live outside the Godot assets in asset-studio/characters/. The earlier reconstructed monsters (2026-10-12) were removed. Selected wolf and rat are credited CC0 derivatives under beasts/, with bound sources and provenance in asset-studio/characters/beasts/. Stone golem is procedural rigid geometry on the local large rig. Studio exports art and animation metadata only; gameplay definitions are separate. The retired direct Quaternius gameplay pack was removed; adopted CC0 creature sources, rigs and provenance remain in Asset Studio. The active first-realm roster uses Studio rat art and the Warden in its own forsaken_warden/ export folder.

packs.name: Rogue Gauntlet - Custom KayKit-Rigged Heroes
packs.author: Rogue Gauntlet contributors (scripted character kit on KayKit CC0 rigs and clips)
packs.notes: Hero models built from the scripted character kit (head, body, outfit pieces). Each GLB is a drop-in for the KayKit adventurer it names as template (kaykit-adventurers/<Class>.glb): that model's Rig, 41 joints, baked clips and prop nodes (1H_Axe, <Class>_Hat, ...) are copied unchanged and only the meshes are ours, so size, orientation, clip names and attachment names match. Concept drawings: Google gemini-3-pro-image over KayKit's CC0 mannequin.
